class.name: BlueprintEditorControl
class.brief_description: Tier 1 architectural floorplan authoring control hosted inside DesignComposer.
class.description: Provides a live [BlueprintPreviewSurface], room/wall/feature telemetry, and quick authoring buttons (Add Sample Room, Add Door, Add Window, Clear) for [BlueprintResource] assets.

method.name: set_blueprint
method.description: Binds a [BlueprintResource] to this editor control.
